title: Youthful Creamy Argentinian Veal Empanadas
description: A sour and creamy Argentinian dish featuring veal, ferment jang, and paleo friendly ingredients, perfect for a festive occasion. This recipe combines the tenderness of veal with the bold flavors of ferment jang and creamy sauce.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the diced veal over medium high heat until browned.
Add the ferment jang, onion, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Roll out the empanada dough and cut out circles of dough.
Place a spoonful of the veal mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the eggs.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
While the empanadas are baking, mix the sour cream and paleo friendly cheese in a bowl.
Serve the empanadas hot with the sour cream and cheese sauce.
